assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Restoring the propagating admission_order call makes queued_placements raise on the pointer with no queued_at, so the equality at line 118 and the absence check at line 122 never hold; the negative-control log records exactly this failure.

A regression that gave the unreadable pointer a place, or that dropped it from the live listing, reddens the row-set equality at line 130, the position/rank None checks at 134-135, or the classification check at 131.
If the narrowing were pushed down into admission_order, tests/test_a_queued_pointer_without_its_time_reads_no_place.py:152 would stop raising and the pytest.raises would fail.

findings.text: admit_once builds its queued list without the readable-queued_at filter (lines 1053-1055) and calls queue_order.admission_order, which still raises ValueError on a pointer whose queued_at does not parse, so a malformed queued pointer remains fatal to the admission pass even though it is now harmless to the read; the node's evidence declares this boundary deliberately and the change does not introduce it.
